First, fetch the existing Jira issue details using the issue ID provided and analyze the current description, comments, and any existing requirements.

**CRITICAL: You MUST format the entire output using JIRA markdown syntax (see JIRA Markdown Format Requirements below). DO NOT use standard markdown or GitHub markdown.**

Then, generate a comprehensive Jira specification that enhances the existing issue with:

1. **Acceptance Criteria** (Product Owner Perspective)
   - User story in proper format (if not already present)
   - Given-When-Then scenarios for all flows (primary, alternative, edge cases)
   - Functional and non-functional requirements
   - Business rules and constraints
   - Error handling and edge cases
   - UX/UI considerations
   - Definition of Done checklist
   - Dependencies and risks

2. **Test Cases** (QA Engineer Perspective)
   - Complete test case specifications with IDs
   - Positive test scenarios (happy path)
   - Negative test scenarios (error handling)
   - Boundary value tests
   - Edge cases and security tests
   - Non-functional tests (performance, security, accessibility, usability)
   - Regression and integration tests
   - Automation recommendations (YES/NO/PARTIAL) with rationale
   - Playwright code examples for automatable tests
   - Test data requirements and test coverage summary

3. **Technical Requirements** (Senior Rails Developer Perspective)
   - Architecture and design patterns selection
   - Database schema changes with zero-downtime migrations
   - API endpoints specification (if applicable) with request/response formats
   - Service objects and business logic organization
   - Background jobs and async processing requirements
   - Performance optimization strategies (query optimization, caching, scalability)
   - Security considerations (authentication, authorization, data protection, input validation)
   - Third-party integrations and webhook handling
   - Error handling and structured logging strategy
   - Code organization structure (services, queries, forms, decorators, policies)
   - Comprehensive testing strategy with RSpec examples (models, services, controllers, jobs)
   - Deployment and rollback considerations with feature flags

**Usage:**
Provide the Jira issue ID (e.g., PROJ-123 or just 123)

**Process:**
1. Fetch the issue details from Jira
2. Analyze existing description, requirements, and context
3. Generate comprehensive specifications based on the issue
4. Format output in **JIRA markdown format** (NOT GitHub/CommonMark markdown) - see examples below
5. Include sections for Acceptance Criteria, Test Cases, and Technical Requirements
6. Attempt to update the Jira issue
7. **If update fails:** Save the generated specification to `/tmp/jira-update-{issue-id}-{timestamp}.md` instead of the root folder

**JIRA Markdown Format Requirements:**
- Headings: `h1.` `h2.` `h3.` `h4.` `h5.` `h6.` (NOT #)
- Bold: `*bold text*` (NOT **)
- Italic: `_italic text_` (NOT *)
- Bullet lists: `*` for bullets, `#` for numbered lists (NOT -)
- Code blocks: `{code:language}...{code}` (NOT ```)
- Inline code: `{{text}}` (NOT backticks)
- Links: `[text|url]` (NOT [text](url))
- Tables: `||heading 1||heading 2||` and `|cell 1|cell 2|`
- Quotes: `{quote}text{quote}` (NOT >)
- Panels: `{panel:title=Title}content{panel}`
- Color: `{color:red}text{color}`
- Line break: Use actual line breaks or `\\`

**JIRA Format Example (User Story Section):**
{code}
h1. User Story

*As a* business customer
*I want to* view the new Platinum Hub homepage
*So that I* can explore Platinum Business products and access role-specific features

h1. Design Reference

* Figma Design: [Design Link|https://www.figma.com/design/example]
* Icon Assets: [Google Drive|https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example]

h1. Acceptance Criteria

h2. AC1: Page Layout and Branding

*Given* a user visits the Platinum Hub homepage
*When* the page loads
*Then* the following elements should be visible:

* IM3 Platinum Business Vertical logo in upper left corner
* "What is Platinum Business" section in left upper corner
* Header navigation with: Toko, Platinum Business, Academy, Wawasan
* Login button OR user icon (if authenticated) in header above banner
* Hero banner on upper right
* Footer with Indosat logo
* Contact email: {{platinumbusiness@ioh.co.id}} in footer
* Social media links pointing to IM3 official channels
{code}

**REMEMBER:**
- Start headings with `h1.` `h2.` etc (with a period and space)
- Use `*text*` for bold (single asterisks)
- Use `_text_` for italic (single underscores)
- Use `{{text}}` for inline code (double curly braces)
- Use `*` at the start of lines for bullet points

**Error Handling:**
- If the Jira update fails (network issues, permissions, etc.), save the generated content to `/tmp/jira-update-{issue-id}-{timestamp}.md`
- Inform the user of the file location so they can manually update Jira or retry later
- Preserve all generated content to avoid data loss

The output will be comprehensive, actionable, and ready for the development team to implement. Each section will be properly formatted for Jira markdown syntax.

fields.description: h1. User Story *As an* admin *I want to* use CMS to upload and manage banners for Platinum Business Hub Homepage *So that I* can display promotional and informational banners to visitors on the homepage h1. Background The CMS currently has banner functionality that needs to be adjusted/configured specifically for the Platinum Business Hub Homepage. Admins should be able to upload, manage, and display banners through the existing CMS interface at https://ide.ioh.co.id/cms/login. ---- h1. Acceptance Criteria h2. AC1: Banner Upload and Management Interface *Given* I am logged into the CMS as an admin *When* I navigate to the banner management section *Then* I should see: * A dedicated section or category for "Platinum Business Hub Homepage" banners * Options to upload new banners * A list of existing banners with their status (active/inactive) * Edit and delete controls for each banner * Preview capability before publishing h2. AC2: Banner Upload Specifications *Given* I am uploading a banner for Platinum Business Hub Homepage *When* I select an image file *Then* the system should: * Accept common image formats (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF) * Validate image dimensions (recommended: minimum 1920x600px for desktop) * Validate file size (maximum 2MB per banner) * Show preview of uploaded image * Allow me to set banner display order/priority * Allow me to set active/inactive status * Allow me to set start and end dates for banner display (optional) * Allow me to add alt text for accessibility * Allow me to set click-through URL (optional) h2. AC3: Banner Display on Homepage *Given* there are active banners configured for Platinum Business Hub Homepage *When* a user visits the Platinum Business Hub Homepage *Then*: * The banner should be displayed in the designated banner area (upper right based on existing description) * If multiple active banners exist, they should rotate/carousel automatically * The banner should be responsive and display correctly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices * The banner image should load with proper lazy loading for performance * If a click-through URL is configured, clicking the banner should navigate to that URL * The banner should respect the active date range if configured h2. AC4: Multiple Banner Support with Carousel *Given* multiple banners are active for the same date/time *When* the homepage loads *Then*: * Banners should display in a carousel/slider format * Auto-rotation should occur every 5 seconds (configurable) * User should see navigation dots/indicators showing total banners and current position * User should be able to manually navigate between banners using previous/next controls * Carousel should pause on hover (desktop) or touch interaction (mobile) h2. AC5: Banner Performance and Optimization *Given* banners are configured *When* the homepage loads *Then*: * Banner images should be optimized and cached * Page load time should not exceed 3 seconds with banner loading * Images should be served via CDN if available * Lazy loading should be implemented for below-the-fold banners h2. AC6: Mobile Responsiveness *Given* a user accesses the homepage from a mobile device *When* the page loads *Then*: * Banner should resize appropriately for mobile screens * Alternative mobile-specific banner images can be uploaded (optional) * Touch gestures (swipe) should work for banner navigation * Banner should not break page layout on any device size ---- h1. Business Rules and Constraints * At least one active banner must be configured for the homepage to display the banner section * If no active banners exist, the banner area should be hidden gracefully * Banner display order should follow priority number (1 = highest priority) * Expired banners should automatically stop displaying * Maximum 10 active banners at any given time to prevent performance issues * Only admins with CMS access can upload and manage banners * Banners must comply with brand guidelines (this should be documented separately) h1. Error Handling and Edge Cases *File Upload Errors:* * If file format is invalid → Show error: "Please upload a valid image file (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF)" * If file size exceeds limit → Show error: "File size must be less than 2MB. Please compress your image." * If dimensions are too small → Show warning: "Image dimensions are below recommended size. Banner may appear pixelated." * If upload fails → Show error: "Upload failed. Please try again or contact support." *Display Errors:* * If banner image fails to load on homepage → Display placeholder or hide banner gracefully * If no active banners → Hide banner section entirely (no empty space) * If API call fails → Use cached banners if available, or hide section *Edge Cases:* * Concurrent banner edits by multiple admins → Last save wins, with timestamp tracking * Banner scheduled for future date → Should not display until start date/time * Banner with past end date → Should stop displaying immediately h1. UX/UI Considerations * Banner carousel should have smooth transitions (fade or slide) * Loading state should show skeleton/shimmer while banner loads * Accessibility: All banners must have alt text for screen readers * Accessibility: Carousel controls must be keyboard navigable * Admin interface should show thumbnail previews for easy identification * Admin interface should show banner status with clear visual indicators (green = active, gray = inactive, yellow = scheduled) ---- h1. Definition of Done * [ ] CMS banner management interface is adjusted/configured for Platinum Business Hub Homepage * [ ] Admins can successfully upload banner images through CMS * [ ] Banner validation works correctly (file type, size, dimensions) * [ ] Banners display correctly on Platinum Business Hub Homepage * [ ] Multiple banners rotate in carousel format if configured * [ ] Banner is responsive on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices * [ ] Click-through URLs work correctly if configured * [ ] Active/inactive status and date ranges are respected * [ ] All error messages are user-friendly and actionable * [ ] Alt text can be configured for accessibility * [ ] Performance metrics meet requirements (page load < 3 seconds) * [ ] Unit tests written and passing for banner models and controllers * [ ] Integration tests written and passing for banner upload and display * [ ] Manual QA testing completed on dev/staging environment * [ ] Code reviewed and approved * [ ] Documentation updated (admin guide for banner management) * [ ] Deployed to staging and verified * [ ] Product Owner approval received ---- h1. Dependencies and Risks *Dependencies:* * Access to CMS admin panel (https://ide.ioh.co.id/cms/login) * Active Storage or file upload library configured in CMS Rails app * CDN configuration for image serving (optional but recommended) * Platinum Business Hub Homepage implementation completed *Risks:* * Large banner files may impact page load performance → Mitigation: Implement strict file size limits and image optimization * Carousel may not work consistently across browsers → Mitigation: Use well-tested carousel library, cross-browser testing * Concurrent admin edits may cause conflicts → Mitigation: Implement last-save-wins with admin notifications *Technical Debt:* * If existing CMS banner functionality is legacy code, refactoring may be needed * Image optimization pipeline may need to be implemented if not present ---- ---- h1. Test Cases (QA Engineer Perspective) h2. Positive Test Scenarios (Happy Path) *TC-001: Upload Valid Banner Image* * *Preconditions:* Admin logged into CMS, has valid image file (1920x600px, JPG, 1.5MB) * *Steps:* ## Navigate to Banner Management → Platinum Business Hub Homepage section ## Click "Upload New Banner" ## Select valid image file ## Fill in alt text: "Platinum Business Promotion" ## Set status to "Active" ## Click "Save" * *Expected Result:* Banner uploads successfully, appears in banner list with "Active" status, preview is shown * *Automation:* YES - File upload and form submission can be automated with Playwright *TC-002: Display Single Active Banner on Homepage* * *Preconditions:* One active banner configured in CMS * *Steps:* ## Visit Platinum Business Hub Homepage ## Observe banner area in upper right section * *Expected Result:* Banner displays correctly with proper dimensions and image quality * *Automation:* YES - Visual regression testing with Playwright screenshot comparison *TC-003: Display Multiple Banners with Carousel* * *Preconditions:* Three active banners configured with priorities 1, 2, 3 * *Steps:* ## Visit Platinum Business Hub Homepage ## Wait for banner to auto-rotate (5 seconds) ## Observe carousel behavior ## Click next/previous controls * *Expected Result:* Banners rotate automatically every 5 seconds, manual navigation works, indicators show correct position (1/3, 2/3, 3/3) * *Automation:* PARTIAL - Auto-rotation can be tested, visual appearance needs manual verification *TC-004: Edit Existing Banner* * *Preconditions:* At least one banner exists * *Steps:* ## Navigate to Banner Management ## Click "Edit" on existing banner ## Change alt text to "Updated Promotion" ## Change status to "Inactive" ## Click "Save" * *Expected Result:* Banner updates successfully, status changes to "Inactive", homepage no longer displays this banner * *Automation:* YES - CRUD operations can be automated *TC-005: Delete Banner* * *Preconditions:* At least one banner exists * *Steps:* ## Navigate to Banner Management ## Click "Delete" on a banner ## Confirm deletion in dialog * *Expected Result:* Banner is removed from list, confirmation message shown, homepage updates accordingly * *Automation:* YES - Delete operation with confirmation can be automated *TC-006: Banner with Click-Through URL* * *Preconditions:* Active banner with URL set to "https://example.com/promo" * *Steps:* ## Visit homepage ## Click on banner image * *Expected Result:* Browser navigates to https://example.com/promo (new tab or same tab based on configuration) * *Automation:* YES - Link navigation can be verified with Playwright *TC-007: Scheduled Banner Display (Future Start Date)* * *Preconditions:* Banner configured with start date = tomorrow, end date = next week * *Steps:* ## Visit homepage today ## Check banner area ## Manually change system date to tomorrow (or wait) ## Visit homepage again * *Expected Result:* Banner does not display today, displays starting tomorrow * *Automation:* PARTIAL - Can mock system time in tests h2. Negative Test Scenarios (Error Handling) *TC-101: Upload Invalid File Format* * *Preconditions:* Admin logged into CMS * *Steps:* ## Attempt to upload PDF file as banner ## Click "Save" * *Expected Result:* Error message: "Please upload a valid image file (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF)", upload is rejected * *Automation:* YES - Error message validation *TC-102: Upload Oversized File* * *Preconditions:* Admin logged into CMS, has image file > 2MB * *Steps:* ## Attempt to upload 3MB image file ## Click "Save" * *Expected Result:* Error message: "File size must be less than 2MB. Please compress your image.", upload is rejected * *Automation:* YES - File size validation *TC-103: Upload Image with Small Dimensions* * *Preconditions:* Admin logged into CMS, has 800x400px image * *Steps:* ## Upload small image ## Click "Save" * *Expected Result:* Warning message: "Image dimensions are below recommended size. Banner may appear pixelated.", but upload is allowed * *Automation:* YES - Warning message validation *TC-104: Save Banner Without Required Fields* * *Preconditions:* Admin on banner upload form * *Steps:* ## Upload image but leave alt text empty ## Click "Save" * *Expected Result:* Error message: "Alt text is required for accessibility", form is not submitted * *Automation:* YES - Form validation testing *TC-105: Network Error During Upload* * *Preconditions:* Admin logged into CMS * *Steps:* ## Start uploading banner ## Simulate network disconnection during upload * *Expected Result:* Error message: "Upload failed. Please try again or contact support.", upload is rolled back * *Automation:* PARTIAL - Can simulate network errors with Playwright but may need manual verification *TC-106: Access Banner Management Without Admin Permissions* * *Preconditions:* User logged in with non-admin role * *Steps:* ## Attempt to navigate to banner management URL directly * *Expected Result:* Access denied, redirect to login or 403 error page * *Automation:* YES - Authorization testing h2. Boundary Value Tests *TC-201: Upload Maximum Allowed File Size (2MB exactly)* * *Expected Result:* Upload succeeds * *Automation:* YES *TC-202: Upload File Just Over Limit (2.01MB)* * *Expected Result:* Upload rejected with error * *Automation:* YES *TC-203: Configure Maximum Number of Active Banners (10)* * *Expected Result:* All 10 banners display and rotate correctly * *Automation:* PARTIAL - Performance testing recommended *TC-204: Attempt to Activate 11th Banner* * *Expected Result:* Warning or error: "Maximum 10 active banners allowed" * *Automation:* YES *TC-205: Alt Text with Maximum Characters (255)* * *Expected Result:* Alt text saves correctly and displays * *Automation:* YES *TC-206: Alt Text Exceeding Limit (256 characters)* * *Expected Result:* Error or truncation with warning * *Automation:* YES h2. Edge Cases and Security Tests *TC-301: XSS Attack via Alt Text* * *Steps:* Enter {{}} in alt text field * *Expected Result:* Script is sanitized/escaped, does not execute on homepage * *Automation:* YES - Security testing *TC-302: SQL Injection via Banner Fields* * *Steps:* Enter {{' OR '1'='1}} in text fields * *Expected Result:* Input is sanitized, no SQL injection occurs * *Automation:* YES - Security testing *TC-303: Upload Malicious File with Image Extension* * *Steps:* Rename malware.exe to malware.jpg and upload * *Expected Result:* File type validation detects invalid file, upload rejected * *Automation:* PARTIAL - Requires malicious file samples *TC-304: Concurrent Banner Edits by Two Admins* * *Steps:* ## Admin A opens banner for editing ## Admin B opens same banner for editing ## Admin A saves changes ## Admin B saves different changes * *Expected Result:* Last save wins (Admin B's changes persist), or conflict resolution dialog appears * *Automation:* PARTIAL - Requires multi-session testing *TC-305: Banner Display When Homepage API is Down* * *Steps:* ## Simulate CMS API failure ## Load homepage * *Expected Result:* Cached banners display if available, or banner section hidden gracefully * *Automation:* YES - Can mock API failures *TC-306: Banner Image 404 Error* * *Steps:* ## Delete banner image file from storage ## Visit homepage * *Expected Result:* Placeholder image or banner hidden gracefully, no broken image icon * *Automation:* YES - Can test broken image handling h2. Non-Functional Tests *TC-401: Page Load Performance with Banners* * *Test:* Load homepage with 5 active banners, measure page load time * *Expected Result:* Total page load time < 3 seconds * *Automation:* YES - Performance testing with Playwright performance APIs *TC-402: Banner Image Lazy Loading* * *Test:* Load homepage and check if below-fold banners lazy load * *Expected Result:* Only visible banner loads initially, others load on scroll or rotation * *Automation:* YES - Network monitoring with Playwright *TC-403: CDN Image Serving* * *Test:* Inspect network requests for banner images * *Expected Result:* Banner images served from CDN URL, not origin server * *Automation:* YES - Network request inspection *TC-404: Mobile Responsiveness (iPhone)* * *Test:* Load homepage on iPhone 14 Pro (390x844) * *Expected Result:* Banner displays correctly, no horizontal scroll, touch gestures work * *Automation:* YES - Mobile emulation with Playwright *TC-405: Mobile Responsiveness (iPad)* * *Test:* Load homepage on iPad Air (820x1180) * *Expected Result:* Banner displays correctly at tablet size * *Automation:* YES - Tablet emulation with Playwright *TC-406: Cross-Browser Compatibility (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)* * *Test:* Load homepage with banners on Chrome, Firefox, Safari * *Expected Result:* Carousel works identically across all browsers * *Automation:* PARTIAL - Requires multiple browser test runs *TC-407: Keyboard Accessibility* * *Test:* Navigate carousel using only keyboard (Tab, Enter, Arrow keys) * *Expected Result:* All carousel controls are keyboard accessible, focus states visible * *Automation:* PARTIAL - Keyboard navigation can be automated, visual focus needs manual check *TC-408: Screen Reader Compatibility* * *Test:* Use screen reader (NVDA/VoiceOver) to navigate banner carousel * *Expected Result:* Alt text is read correctly, carousel controls are announced properly * *Automation:* NO - Requires manual testing with screen readers h2. Integration Tests *TC-501: CMS to Homepage Data Flow* * *Test:* Upload banner in CMS, verify it appears on homepage within expected time (immediate or cached refresh) * *Expected Result:* Banner data flows correctly from CMS to homepage API/cache * *Automation:* YES - End-to-end testing *TC-502: Banner Update Propagation* * *Test:* Update active banner to inactive in CMS, check homepage updates * *Expected Result:* Homepage reflects change within cache invalidation time * *Automation:* YES *TC-503: Scheduled Banner Activation Integration* * *Test:* Create banner with start time = 2 minutes from now, wait and check homepage * *Expected Result:* Banner appears automatically at scheduled time * *Automation:* PARTIAL - Time-based testing h2. Regression Tests *TC-601: Existing CMS Features Still Work* * *Test:* Verify other CMS features (events, FAQs, pricing management) are not affected * *Expected Result:* No regression in existing functionality * *Automation:* YES - Smoke test suite *TC-602: Other Homepage Elements Unchanged* * *Test:* Verify header, footer, navigation, content sections still render correctly * *Expected Result:* No layout breaks or style conflicts * *Automation:* YES - Visual regression testing h2. Test Data Requirements * Valid banner images: 1920x600px JPG (500KB, 1.5MB, 2MB) * Valid banner images: 1920x600px PNG (500KB, 1.5MB) * Valid banner images: 1920x600px WebP (500KB) * Invalid files: PDF, TXT, EXE files with various extensions * Small dimension images: 800x400px, 500x200px * Large dimension images: 3840x1200px (4K) * Oversized files: 3MB, 5MB, 10MB * Test URLs for click-through: https://example.com/test1, https://example.com/test2 * Alt text samples: Short (10 chars), Medium (100 chars), Long (255 chars), Oversized (300 chars) * XSS payloads: {{}}, {{}} * SQL injection payloads: {{' OR '1'='1}}, {{1'; DROP TABLE banners;--}} h2. AC4: Multiple Banner Support with Carousel *Given* multiple banners are active for the same date/time *When* the homepage loads *Then*: * Banners should display in a carousel/slider format * Auto-rotation should occur every 5 seconds (configurable) * User should see navigation dots/indicators showing total banners and current position * User should be able to manually navigate between banners using previous/next controls * Carousel should pause on hover (desktop) or touch interaction (mobile) h2. *So that I* can display promotional and informational banners to visitors on the homepage

h1. Acceptance Criteria Summary

h2. AC1: Banner Upload and Management Interface
Admins can access a dedicated "Platinum Business Hub Homepage" banner section in CMS with upload, edit, delete, and preview capabilities.

h2. AC2: Banner Upload Specifications
* Accepts: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF (max 2MB, recommended 1920x600px)
* Configurable: alt text, priority/order, active/inactive status, start/end dates, click-through URL

h2. AC3: Banner Display on Homepage
* Displays in designated banner area (upper right)
* Responsive across desktop, tablet, mobile
* Lazy loading for performance
* Respects active date ranges and status

h2. AC4: Multiple Banner Support
* Carousel rotation every 5 seconds (configurable)
* Navigation dots and manual controls
* Auto-pause on hover/touch
* Maximum 10 active banners per placement

h2. AC5: Performance Requirements
* Page load time < 3 seconds with banners
* CDN image serving
* Proper caching and optimization

h2. AC6: Mobile Responsiveness
* Banner resizes for mobile screens
* Touch gestures (swipe) for navigation
* No layout breaks on any device size

h1. Business Rules

* Maximum 10 active banners at any time
* Priority-based display order (1 = highest)
* Automated activation/expiration based on dates
* Admin-only access to banner management
* Graceful handling when no banners are active

h1. Error Handling

*Upload Errors:*
* Invalid format → "Please upload a valid image file (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF)"
* Oversized file → "File size must be less than 2MB. Please compress your image."
* Small dimensions → Warning about potential pixelation

*Display Errors:*
* Failed image load → Hide banner gracefully or show placeholder
* No active banners → Hide section entirely
* API failure → Use cached banners or hide section

* [ ] CMS interface configured for Platinum Business Hub Homepage banners

* [ ] Validation working (file type, size, dimensions)

* [ ] Carousel functionality working for multiple banners
* [ ] Responsive on all devices (desktop, tablet, mobile)
* [ ] Click-through URLs functional
* [ ] Date range scheduling working

* [ ] Unit and integration tests passing
* [ ] Manual QA completed on staging
* [ ] Code reviewed and approved
* [ ] Documentation updated

* Partially Automated: 8 cases (18%)
* Manual Only: 5 cases (11%)
